source: Han, Glaz, Haile, Lai, Phys. Rev. Research 3, 023156 (2021), arXiv:2102.13235, Fig.3(a) + §III.B text
metric: relative potential error <ΔV> vs bifurcation parameter λ, Hénon–Heiles, E=1/6
digitization_method: STATED BOUNDS (not point-digitized): the paper's figures are embedded as tiled FlateDecode RGB rasters with an opaque tile layout and no PDF rendering tooling available in this env; the paper does not tabulate Fig.3a. We therefore overlay the paper's explicit quoted bounds rather than fabricate pixel-read points.
quotes: In the shaded region that contains these four values of λ, the relative error is less than 2%.
The adaptability extends even outside the shaded region but with larger error (still within 8% though).
note: AHNN reported these for an ENSEMBLE of 20 networks. Our reimplementation trains single nets (5 seeds). Agreement to be read as order-of-magnitude/band, not point-wise.
